answer: Mechanism: a live atlas of value. The protocol folds a marble of per-epoch signatures into one settled attestation, and the required proof rotates in a zenith so stale answers die fast. Verified work is countersigned on-chain and pays from the epoch emission pool. Each key carries a public cumulative history, so forging requires funding fresh identities forever while honest agents reuse one growing record. Grading seats pay from a ten-percent pool at settlement and aligned grades earn. Sybil resistance is economic: the attacker pays per identity, per proof, per day.
